_comment: Hand-checked chapter boundaries for the Srivastava Vigyan Bhashya (see corpus/bhashya.py). English: inclusive ranges of '## Source page N' blocks; a chapter starts on the page carrying its '(Brief Description)' summary and runs to the page before the next chapter's, so a boundary page holding the tail of the previous chapter is counted with the new one. Pages outside every range (front matter 1-23, Volume II front matter 463-465, appendix and bibliography 834-838) get chapter null. The page numbers agree with the Volume II table of contents (printed page + 25 = scan page, e.g. Ch.6 printed 545 -> scan 570). Hindi: 'anchor' is the exact text of a line (markdown '#' and surrounding whitespace removed), found in order, each searched only after the previous one, so the same text earlier in the file (the tables of contents) cannot match. 'line_hint' is the 1-based line it was found on when this file was checked; it is documentation only and is not used for lookup. A boundary with chapter null starts uncategorised text (front matter, appendix). Chapters 4, 5, 8 and 14 have no '##' heading in the OCR; their anchors are the plain body lines 'चतुर्थ अध्याय', 'पंचम अध्याय', 'अष्टम अध्याय', 'चतुर्दश अध्याय', each followed by the adhikara name and '(संक्षिप्त वर्णन)', and each preceded by the previous chapter's closing line ('... का विज्ञानभाष्य समाप्त हुआ').
